diagnostics.accepted: At most 64 diagnostics are returned in deterministic order.
diagnostics.safe_remediation: Fix the reported diagnostics and run the check again.

diagnostics.accepted: A declared entity id and shape must match the project contract.
diagnostics.safe_remediation: Correct the entity declaration with the entity schema and its project alias.

diagnostics.accepted: Environment bindings must match declared products, integrations, identities, origins, and bounded generations.
diagnostics.safe_remediation: Align the selected environment with the declared project contract.

diagnostics.accepted: Authored files must remain below their documented fixed byte bound.
diagnostics.safe_remediation: Reduce the file below its documented maximum size.

diagnostics.accepted: A regular file inside the project root must be readable.
diagnostics.safe_remediation: Restore a readable regular project-relative file.

diagnostics.accepted: Fixtures must be deterministic, bounded, and satisfy the integration contract without live values.
diagnostics.safe_remediation: Correct the fixture declaration and its closed interaction contract.

diagnostics.accepted: A fixture body object may use `file` only as the closed body-file reference shape.
diagnostics.safe_remediation: Use the documented body-file reference shape or an inline JSON body.

diagnostics.accepted: An integration alias, capability, and declared contract must be internally consistent.
diagnostics.safe_remediation: Correct the integration declaration with the integration schema.

diagnostics.accepted: Paths must be normalized project-relative paths to regular non-symlink entries.
diagnostics.safe_remediation: Use a normalized project-relative regular file path.

diagnostics.accepted: Project services, entities, integrations, and references must form a closed valid graph.
diagnostics.safe_remediation: Align the project declaration and referenced contracts.

diagnostics.accepted: Effective authorization scopes must be distinct across records API and attribute-release access.
diagnostics.safe_remediation: Assign distinct scopes to each authorization purpose.

diagnostics.accepted: Scripts must use the released bounded Script contract and module rules.
diagnostics.safe_remediation: Use only the released bounded Script contract.

diagnostics.accepted: The Script entrypoint must be exactly `consult(context)`.
diagnostics.safe_remediation: Define the exact released entrypoint signature.

diagnostics.accepted: The Script source must parse under the released runtime.
diagnostics.safe_remediation: Correct the Script syntax at the reported location.

diagnostics.accepted: The Script must define the released `consult(context)` entrypoint.
diagnostics.safe_remediation: Define consult(context) as the Script entrypoint.

diagnostics.accepted: YAML must parse as the selected closed authoring document shape.
diagnostics.safe_remediation: Correct the YAML with the matching authoring schema.

diagnostics.accepted: Only documented fields in the closed authoring schema are accepted.
diagnostics.safe_remediation: Remove the unsupported field or replace it with its documented field.
diagnostics.replacement: No deprecated replacement is implied by an unknown field; use only a documented field.
diagnostics.changed_behavior: Unknown fields are rejected rather than ignored.
